name: Goodberry
summary: Creates ten magic berries that each restore 1 Hit Point and a day's nourishment.

stats.effect:
Ten berries appear in your hand and are infused with magic for the duration. A creature can take a {ref:glossary/bonus-action} to eat one berry. Eating a berry restores 1 Hit Point, and the berry provides enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day.

Uneaten berries disappear when the spell ends.
